config.voxyworldgenv2.title: Voxy World Gen V2 Config
config.voxyworldgenv2.server.readonly: §7These are the server's settings. Only a server operator can change them.
config.voxyworldgenv2.option.enabled.too: Completely enable or disable the mod's generation logic.
config.voxyworldgenv2.option.f3_stats.to: Show generation statistics in the F3 debug menu.
config.voxyworldgenv2.option.radius.tool: The radius (in chunks) around players to generate.
config.voxyworldgenv2.option.update_inte: How often to scan for new ungenerated chunks.
config.voxyworldgenv2.option.max_queue.t: Maximum number of chunks to keep in the pending queue.
Maximum number of chunks generating simultaneously.
voxyworldgenv2.option.hud_compressed.too: Show post-compression wire traffic in the hold-Tab HUD.
voxyworldgenv2.option.hud_savings.toolti: Show how much the LOD stream saved by compressing.
voxyworldgenv2.option.hud_client_disk.to: Show how much disk Voxy's local LOD store is using.
voxyworldgenv2.option.gen_enabled.toolti: Whether the server generates and streams LOD chunks at all.
voxyworldgenv2.option.gen_radius.tooltip: How far from each player the server keeps generating, in chunks. Server-wide; operators only.
voxyworldgenv2.option.max_tasks.tooltip: How many chunks the server generates at once. Higher fills faster and costs more CPU.
